rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda, Cl..
Registration name: TANolokip
Exhibition name: Piccolo ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Mathias Tantau, Jr. (1912 - 2006) (Germany, before 1984).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Wheatcroft Brothers Ltd. in 1984 as 'Piccolo'.
rows.Bloom: Coral-red. Mild fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Climbing, compact.

Height: 18" to 2' (45 to 60cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Notes: In his column Roses Abroad in the January 1998 issue of the American Rose magazine (pp.16-7), Sean McCann writes: I found the German-bred, coral red Piccolo to be ideal where cut blooms and a low growing bush were needed. A few years ago I planted it as a low hedge, and it was superb.
